title: A Crown Worth Waiting For
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people came to David's side,
"Be king, and lead us on!"
He'd waited long, he'd waited well,
The long, long wait was gone.

[Chorus]
Good things will come in God's own time,
So wait and trust His way.
Be patient, faithful, kind, and true,
And blessings come one day.

[Verse 2]
Jerusalem became his home,
The city of the king.
For forty years he ruled with love,
And God blessed everything.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the day is done,
The night can take its turn.
God's near, and His good time is best,
A truth to keep and learn.

[Chorus]
mood: Processional music. A slow, stately walking pulse moves under the voice like a long road finally arriving at a city gate, patient and sure, matching David's years of quiet waiting. The chorus rises with the calm confidence of a promise kept. By the last verse the procession slows to a rest, lower and softer, like a crown laid gently down for the night.
